settings.title: How does it work?
settings.content:
Here’s the breakdown of our process:

  • Subscription: You can select any one of our subscription plans ranging from 3 months to 12 months.
  • Book Selection: You can select books from our online catalog. We have an in-house expert available if you need any help with recommendations!
  • First delivery: Books get delivered right to your doorstep for the month.
  • First return: At the end of 30 days with your first set of books, our delivery partner will come to your doorstep to pick them up and give you a fresh new set of books.
  • Repeat: This process will continue month after month until you end your subscription.

settings.title: What will I get in the neOwn Book Library Subscription?
settings.content:
Your neOwn Book Library Subscription will contain:

  • 5 books per month
  • Online catalog of 10,000+ books to select from
  • Help available from expert if needed
  • Free pick up and drop services in Mumbai
  • Free goodies!
  • Free Community for Moms & Kids (activities & expert sessions)!

settings.title: Can I cancel anytime?
settings.content:
At this time, we do not offer order cancellation.

In case you’re facing any problems or are unhappy with your subscription, we’d love to hear what you would like us to change or improve! WhatsApp us on 9137081640, or you can get in touch directly with our founder at kranti@neown.in.

settings.title: How do I choose my books?
settings.content: Once you’ve bought the neOwn Book Library Subscription, we'll send you an online catalog where you can select your books. If you need any recommendations, we have an in-house expert available for help.

settings.title: When will my neOwn Subscription be shipped?
settings.content: Once you have selected your items, delivery will occur within 2-5 working days. If you have any more questions, feel free to get in touch with us at +91 9137081640

settings.title: Do I have to return the products?
settings.content: We’ll send our delivery partner directly to your doorstep for the delivery and the pickup of the items. All you have to do is be available to receive the delivery and keep the items packed when it's time for the pickup.

settings.title: Can I pause my subscription?
settings.content: Yes - if you have an active subscription and you need to take a break in between months, you can pause your subscription for minimum 7 days and maximum 30 days. Please speak with our team at +91 9137081640 for more details!
